name: Pla i Llevant
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A DO on Mallorca whose name means plain and east coast. Rules allow still, semi-sparkling, sparkling and liqueur wines from local grapes like Manto Negro, Callet and Moll, as well as Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Chardonnay.
